description: Calculate zakat (الزكاة) on personal savings or a trading business at 2.5%, with the nisab worked out from the live gold price (85 g) unless a gold price is given. Web version: https://irfanaslam.io/tools/zakat-calculator

business.description: True for a trading business or shop.

gold_and_investments.description: Value of gold, silver and investments held for a year (SAR).

gold_price_per_gram_sar.description: Optional 24K gold price per gram in SAR; fetched live if omitted.

goods_for_sale.description: business: goods for sale at today's market value (SAR).

gregorian_year.description: business: financial year is Gregorian (rate scaled by 365/354).

receivables.description: Money owed to you that you expect to collect (SAR).

name: zakat
title: Zakat calculator
